summary: The Backrooms is a survival RPG with a shared Bonus Room mall and player-specific Backrooms rooms; players create a character, follow the solo Level 0 tutorial, then enter the maze or return to the mall. The player template composes shared combat, interaction, building, UI and routing behaviors, while authored places and simulation scripts supply their layouts and local systems.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with diner, clothes and furniture counters, arcade, teleport station and mall residents; layout data is scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml.
places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, authored yellow maze and safe-room hub with fixtures, hunters and lore props.
places/intake (3D) - standalone bedroom character-creation room; authored props and scripts/intake-geo.js shell.
places/tutorial0 (3D, solo ephemeral) - authored Level 0 route, staged encounter, HALOGEN machine, drawings, wet-carpet fall and local props/lights.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus simulated Level 2.1 rooms, zones and agents.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards and Boiler Room Death Rats.
places/level6, places/level61, places/level7, places/level8 (3D) - Lights Out, Snackrooms, ocean/Seawatch and Fort Surrender; services, camps, caves and traders.

places/level10, places/level11, places/home11, places/debug, places/spamton and other numbered places - farm, generated city, owner-specific furnished home, test room, basement showroom/boss arena and separate levels.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry, player actions and HUD, routing, player cap and Backspace menu action.
templates/player.js + templates/camera.js; scripts/camera.js - ordered player behavior (including build and hub) and camera entry; view3 supplies third-person mode.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells + sim.js - place setup and placements; sims build or tick place-local layouts and behavior.
sim.js - world cadence and out-of-bounds handling: players respawn, creatures with state.home return, others are destroyed for manager respawn.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - local title/pause, character creation, intro/arrival and tutorial routing; completed players launch to the Bonus Room.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and timed local waking sequence after character creation.
places/tutorial0/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/tut0-geo.js + scripts/tut0-panels-geo.js + places/tutorial0/sim.js - hand-authored route geometry and props/lights from scripts/lib/tut0.js.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/hub-ui.js + scripts/build-ui.js + scripts/cutscene-ui.js - compose HUD, mall counter menu, build menu and tutorial/cutscene presentation.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations, and toHub/toSolo crossings; imported by scripts/routing.js and scripts/hub.js.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build piece specs/models for B-mode and home rebuilds; furniture.yml defines mall-unlocked furniture.
scripts/lib/screen.js - read-only current-screen classifier and wrist-panel gate/replacer shared by player, stats, craft, rest and menu input.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js through level7.js + data - per-level grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by sims, geometry, labels and navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml and scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/model, clothes and face data - shared garment/body/species/head construction; Phoebe uses the same critter base and attached outfit model.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data; scripts/lib/combat.js + combat.yml + scripts/lib/ballistics.js - shared item/container and player/NPC hit, armor and firearm rules.
scripts/lib/nav.js + builtin/nav; scripts/lib/footsteps.js + footsteps.yml; quest libraries level8/10/11/21 - shared pathing, surface sounds and quest definitions consumed by NPC/talk systems.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, L11_FAR, l11Lean, tick.
places/home11/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update; scripts/build.js - onInput, update.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js - pieceOf, tabsFor, furnOrder, furnModel, hingeOf, builtSpec; scripts/hub.js - clothName, update, onInput; scripts/hub-ui.js - hubUi.
scripts/lib/hub.js - HUB_ROOM, HUB_PLACE, isHubRoom, soloRoom, HOMES, toHub, toSolo; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; scripts/bonus-counter.js - ears.press.
scripts/lib/level8-quests.js and level21-quests.js - quest definitions, setters, finishers and dialogue handlers; level10-quests.js and level11-quests.js - corresponding quest APIs.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack and combat/progression/input/fishing handlers; scripts/lib/body3.js - swing3, fire3, stance.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/lib/level11-shop.js - SHOP, layShop; scripts/lib/level11-elevator.js - elevator schedule/call/ears/update; scripts/l11-traffic.js - update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, appearance, karma/rep and level access.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; player.state.homeKeep.built persists owned-home builds, replayed by places/home11/sim.js via build-piece.js.
scripts/hub.js - local mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags; mall transactions update player.state.cents, furn, cloth and hubFood, while scripts/lib/hub.js performs crossings.
scripts/grab.js - player carry/carryId/carryMul and session held-object state; strength, load, health and stamina limit lifting.
scripts/lib/fishing.js - player.state.fishingState session and canonical water checks, bite/reel outcome and location loot; scripts/bobber.js owns spawned float/session state.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; interact.js + lib/seat.js own focus, loot and sit state and configured storage saves.
scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI, rapport/trade/rep and authored-choice effects; quest libraries own quest keys/HUD/payout; scripts/l8-use.js owns Level 8 interaction flags.
scripts/main-menu.js - menu/intake/intro/arrival/tutorial route state (menuOpen, madeChar, cut, arrivePending, arrive, tut, t0n, t0cut, t0Done); intro-cut owns local beat flags/effects.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde/critter/main-menu/hub/view3; routing is configured there.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.

scripts/routing.js pickRoom accepts a permitted requested room; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room, while Bonus Room requests overflow to bonus-2, bonus-3, etc.
Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js title menu; START enters intake for character creation, or a completed character goes to bonus; wardrobe close runs intro-cut, then tutorial0 unless t0Done.

scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings; roomHop prevents menu launch/resume logic from treating a walk as a fresh launch; mall travel returns to that player's solo Level 0 or an eligible home.

After recovery from a death outside bonus, scripts/hub.js sets hubOffer → hub-ui.js renders offer and hub action returns via toHub; local player hub handler owns offers, mall food/clothes/furniture purchases and teleport choices.

Placed bonus-counter.js ears.press writes the interacting player's hubShop from counter kind → scripts/hub.js handles hub input → scripts/hub-ui.js renders diner/clothes/furniture/station menu; purchases debit cents and grant the matching saved item/unlock.

Mall furniture unlock in player.state.furn → build-piece.js furn_ piece rows/tabs → scripts/build.js B-mode places models; build UI renders selection and lib/build-piece.js makes the matching piece spec.

In an owner's home, scripts/build.js writes homeKeep.built → places/home11/sim.js rebuilds those specs with lib/build-piece.js alongside the authored home; interact.js storage saveKey persists fridge contents to player.state.

Main-menu arrival routing consumes arrivePending in main/tutorial0 → scripts/lib/arrive-cut.js stages landing → scripts/lib/tutorial.js starts walking tutorial; tutorial0 t0Tick then runs local staged beats.

places/tutorial0/sim.js lays props/lights from scripts/lib/tut0.js; scripts/main-menu.js polls scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js, which writes t0cut/t0n and local pose/camera/effects → cutscene-ui.js captions and scripts/ui.js t0Fade.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps paired IDs and writes arrival clipKind/calls companion.bring → followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind to xfer.kind and noclip-ui renders transition.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml - mall shell, arcade/court/diner landmarks and fixtures share one authored site; counter kinds and stock/price/menu content vary by shop data.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - furniture models/dimensions vary by catalog piece while a common build-spec and home-save/rebuild path places them.
places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and red-zone variants; Level 5 has portal/quest props and scripts/l5-rats.js Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout, fixture variants, resident schedules and home claims.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies shared combat/social behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + scripts/lib/data/craft.yml - recipes vary by category, cost, skill, bench and output; canonical weapon IDs connect crafting to equip/combat/condition.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js; places/level61/sim.js + level61-extra.js and l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - generated room/venue and service systems vary by room type, menu and Faceling role.
scripts/lib/level11-city.js + level11-models.yml + art/level11 kits - generated buildings/props vary by seeded district/model/placement; sim adds city life, traffic, tram, advert and canal crossings.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room is the shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room, and overflowing requested bonus rooms get bonus-N IDs. Keep routing and hub room/place identity aligned.

A roomHop distinguishes intentional mall/home crossings from launch/resume; hub.js clears failed hops and expires the flag. The shared mall is non-survival: food is local to the mall, craft skips it, and hunger does not drain there.

Furniture bought in the mall unlocks player.state.furn; B-mode identifies it as furn_<key>. Home builds persist in homeKeep.built and are reconstructed by home11 sim through the shared build-piece spec; preserve compatible stored piece rows.

scripts/lib/tut0.js is the shared route coordinate source for geometry, scene placements, simulation props and beat positions; tutorial beats run locally from the player's main-menu behavior, not the place referee.
HALOGEN stat creation uses state.creating and state.sheetOpen; points and three skill tags must be allocated before DONE/close succeeds, and the halogen beat waits for sheet closure.

scripts/lib/screen.js is derived, read-only state: priority is cutscene, menu, wardrobe, mahjong, talk, loot, wrist sheet/inventory/craft/rest, then play. Only wrist panels can replace another wrist panel; closing remains available.
